searchText: At what point is the blocksize limit increases deemed malicious? Miners are switching to ETC after the merge so they have an interest in ruining ETH before that maybe. They can do that by raising blocksize limit alot from now until then. How does raising the blocksize ruin ETH? Nobody can run nodes Nodes ensure that miners or validators don't behave maliciously it would need to get way too large. miners and validators are incentivised to keep the network running, not ruin it As a compromise for hardcoding blocksize to 30mm, perhaps decrease blocktime to 2 blocks per second or something fast? It's gas/second that's the metric here, decreasing the blocks per second while keeping the blocksize the same only makes it worse The metric is whether we have the miners and validators decide the network's capacity (blocksize), or the ECD. The solution proposed in EIP-3756 means very high tx fees forever Does anyone have info on what the currently preferred way to do "sign in with ethereum" is? I would like anyonen with a metamask wallet to be able to use it to log in on my website. No e-mail, no passwords, just sign in with your ethereum address. Doesn't even need to have any ETH in it. I believe there was some buzz around this?
